NOVELTY STATEMENT  
Standard practice delivers a MONITORING/INDICATION scheme using mat thickness deviation as the primary indicator. Our mechanism departs by inferring screed edge wear from the nonlinear damping of screed vibration amplitude at constant frequency and extension-plate position. This works because edge thinning reduces screed mass stiffness, increasing vibration amplitude decay rate under constant force.  

PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing relation: Damping ratio ζ ∝ (vibration amplitude decay rate) / (2π × frequency). For a 4 mm wear (5% mass loss), ζ increases by ~2.5% (CALCULATED: ζ = c/(2√(mk)), m↓5% → ζ↑2.5%). Detectable as amplitude decay rate change >1.5% (ASSUMPTION: sensor resolution ±0.5 Hz/amplitude).  

IMPLEMENTATION BILL  
- Inputs:  
  - ALREADY-RECORDED: "screed vibration frequency" (Hz) per shift log (source: paver logs)  
  - ALREADY-RECORDED: "screed vibration amplitude" (mm) per shift log (source: paver logs)  
  - ALREADY-RECORDED: "extension-plate position" (mm) per shift log (source: paver logs)  
  - ALREADY-RECORDDED: "mat thickness deviation" (mm) per meter (source: grade control logs)  
- Reference threshold: DERIVED from stated physics: vibration amplitude decay rate threshold = 1.5% (CALCULATED: ζ increase from 5% mass loss).  
- Procedure: Compute amplitude decay rate over 10-second windows at constant frequency/extension; trigger if rate exceeds threshold.  

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)  
- Installability: Same (uses existing logs)  
- Operability: Same (no new training; automated flag)  
- Maintenance: Same (no new hardware)  
- Cost class: SAME (no added instruments or labor)  
- Burden difference: None (reuses existing data streams).  

EXECUTABLE TEST  
- Protocol: Analyze 3 months of historical log data (200 km paving) with known wear events.  
- Instruments: Existing log data (no new hardware).  
- Pass/fail: Must detect wear events with <10% false alarms and >90% lead time (150 m).  
- Duration: 1 day (historical data analysis).  
- Kill criterion: If false alarms >1 per 10 km or lead time <150 m, mechanism fails.  

CONSTRAINT BIND  
Primary indicator: Mat thickness deviation (stated as failure-defining quantity). Our mechanism supplements it by inferring wear cause from vibration data, but threshold is still based on 4 mm mat drift.
